📋 Daily Workout Plan Summary — Key Findings

🏋️ WORKOUT TYPES:
• Strength Training — Compound lifts (squats, deadlifts, bench press) → Muscle & metabolism
• Cardio — Running, cycling, HIIT, jump rope → Fat loss & endurance
• Mobility/Flexibility — Yoga, stretching, foam rolling → Recovery & injury prevention

📅 BEGINNER SCHEDULE (3–4 Days/Week):
• Mon: Full Body Strength (Squats, Push-ups, Dumbbell Rows)
• Wed: Cardio + Core
• Fri: Full Body Strength (variation)
• Sun: Active Recovery / Mobility

💡 CORE PRINCIPLES:
• Progressive overload — increase weight/reps gradually
• Rest days matter — muscles grow during recovery
• Consistency > Intensity — show up regularly
• Nutrition supports training — protein intake is key
• Sleep 7–9 hrs — essential for performance & recovery

🎯 GOAL-BASED FOCUS:
• Fat Loss → Cardio + Strength combo + calorie deficit
• Muscle Gain → Progressive strength training + caloric surplus
• Endurance → Cardio-heavy with long slow-distance runs
• General Fitness → Balanced mix of all three types
